title: Verifier-assisted generate–validate–repair reduces unsafe LLM fixes for network configurations (repaired preregistration)
research_question: Does integrating a formal network verifier into a generate–validate–repair loop reduce the proportion of LLM-suggested configuration repairs that violate stated reachability/isolation properties compared with LLM-only repairs?
confirmatory_hypotheses: H1: The verifier-assisted pipeline yields a higher paired proportion of final repairs that pass formal verification than LLM-only repairs (estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline).
H2: The verifier-assisted pipeline produces a lower rate of syntactically-plausible but semantically-incorrect edits (hallucinated-change proxy, automatically detected) than LLM-only repairs.
H3: The verifier-assisted pipeline increases median wall-clock latency per repair modestly vs baseline.
exploratory_questions: E1: Does effect size vary by device dialect (vendor CLI family) or by fault class (routing vs ACL vs interface misconfig)?
E2: How sensitive are hallucination-rate estimates to the automated-detection heuristic thresholds?
benchmark_scope: Paired synthetic+public real-world faulty-config instances (intentional misconfigurations) restricted to the adapter task profile challenging_workflow_stress_v1 (difficulty: very_hard/extreme).
Device dialect strata: {vendorA-like, vendorB-like, vendorC-like} represented via generator dialect labels (quota pre-specified).
model_scope: Hosted LLM API (single hosted model): openai/gpt-4o (model_name and model_version recorded in adapter runtime configuration).
transformation_scope: guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (LLM repair + verifier feedback loop up to 1 feedback iteration per adapter contract)
sampling_plan: Confirmatory paired sample with deterministic task_index profile challenging_workflow_stress_v1. Task_count (confirmatory items) is set per budget/power scenario (see Budget Scenarios). For each selected task index: one shared initial generation (baseline and guarded share initial faulty instance) and up to one guarded repair call if initial repair fails deterministic validation; adapter contract enforces at most 2 model calls per task and episodes_per_task=2. Per-vendor quotas: enforce minimum 20% per declared dialect stratum when task_count>=100; exact per-stratum counts computed deterministically from task_index list before execution.
analysis_plan: Primary confirmatory analysis executed by paired_binary_analysis_v1 executor (McNemar-style paired binary test). Report paired difference in success proportions (guarded - baseline) with two-sided 95% CI and p-value. Secondary analyses: automated-hallucination-proxy rate with Wilson CI; latency median/IQR and Wilcoxon signed-rank test. Subgroup analyses by dialect and fault class with Bonferroni correction. Sensitivity analysis: failed-call treatment using the compatible failed_call_treatment options: (1) primary: complete_pair_primary (drop pairs where both conditions absent) and (2) sensitivity: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat missing/failed as zero success). All model calls, seeds, and raw verifier outputs logged for reproducibility.
multiplicity_plan: Pre-specified primary estimand only. Subgroup and secondary analyses are explicitly exploratory; apply Bonferroni correction for K subgroup tests (K pre-declared: 3 dialects + 3 fault classes = 6). Report unadjusted and adjusted p-values; interpret adjusted as confirmatory only if surviving correction.
missingness_plan: Salvageability rule: a task is 'unsalvageable' if both baseline and guarded final outputs fail syntactic parse or the guarded pipeline's verifier cannot produce a verdict due to parser error. Handling: primary analysis uses complete_pair_primary; sensitivity analysis treats unsalvageable pairs as failures (success=0) under complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity. All unsalvageable counts and causes logged; deterministic exclusion/inclusion rules are pre-registered.

risk_factors: Prompt leakage of ground-truth repair into test prompt templates (data contamination)
Verifier blind spots (false negatives) yielding apparent but incorrect passes
detection_procedures: Deterministic prompt integrity check: verify no task-specific ground-truth solution tokens are present in prompt templates prior to model calls (automated string-based scan).
Dual-verifier disagreement check: compare primary verifier verdict with independent secondary validator (see Transformation Validation). Flag disagreements deterministically.
Re-run deterministic subset (fixed RNG seeds) to estimate model-call nondeterminism variance; report discordant rate.
item_flagging_rules: If primary verifier PASS and secondary validator FAIL -> flagged for conservative counting (treated as FAIL in conservative sensitivity analysis).
If prompt integrity check finds forbidden substrings -> task excluded from confirmatory analysis and logged.
contamination_plan.analysis_treatment: Primary analysis uses primary verifier verdict; conservative sensitivity analysis re-labels flagged items as failures. All flagged items reported with raw logs.
residual_uncertainty: Verifier coverage gaps (undetected unsafe repairs) remain; addressed via dual-verifier sensitivity analyses but not fully eliminable.
Model non-determinism yields sampling variance; mitigated by deterministic seeds and reporting.

budget_scenarios.description: Minimal confirmatory run to detect large effects (fast/low-cost).
budget_scenarios.feasibility_rationale: Model calls = confirmatory_items * 2 = 100 * 2 = 200, within capability manifest maximum_planned_model_calls (10000). Docker available for verifier. Detects large (>~25 percentage point) paired differences with limited power.

budget_scenarios.description: Recommended balanced run: powered for medium effect sizes while staying within candidate-estimate and model-call constraints.
budget_scenarios.feasibility_rationale: Model calls = 600 * 2 = 1,200. Candidate estimated_model_calls=1800; 1,200 is below that estimate and well within maximum_planned_model_calls. Docker-based Batfish verifier (primary) plus CPU-based secondary validator fit the available CPU/docker resources; hosted LLM calls feasible under hosted_model_api_available.

budget_scenarios.description: Higher-powered confirmatory run to detect smaller effects and enable richer subgroup splits.
budget_scenarios.feasibility_rationale: Model calls = 800 * 2 = 1,600. Within candidate estimate (1,800) and overall manifest limit (10,000). Larger sample improves power for subgroup analyses at modest additional API cost.

power_plan.target_effect: 15 percentage points absolute increase (e.g., baseline 55% -> guarded 70%)
power_plan.calculation_method: Approximate paired-proportion/McNemar sample-size reasoning: using two-sided alpha=0.05, power=0.80 and conservative discordant-pair assumptions yields required N≈580; we round up to 600 for recommended scenario.
assumptions: Baseline paired-pass rate ≈ 0.55 (based on literature C3/C1 indicative ranges).
Discordant-pair proportion (proportion of tasks where baseline and guarded disagree) ≈ 0.25 assumed for variance calculation; sensitivity analyses for discordant ∈ {0.15,0.35}.
power_plan.minimum_detectable_effect_notes: With N=600, under assumptions above, the study is powered to detect ≈15 percentage-point paired differences. If discordant proportions are lower, detectable MDE increases; report MDE sensitivity table in analysis.
sensitivity_analyses: Recompute MDE under discordant-pair proportions 0.15 and 0.35.
Secondary sensitivity: treat failed/missing pairs as failures (failure-as-zero) to produce conservative effect estimates.

transformation_families: semantic_verification_secondary (independent lightweight graph-based reachability validator using sanitized topology and NetworkX abstractions)
compare_and_feedback (counterexample schema returned to LLM as concise failure token + minimal counterexample context)
semantic_equivalence_checks: No-additional-entity rule: final repair must not introduce configuration entities (e.g., new ACL names, VRFs) outside a pre-declared allowed set unless the LLM justifies the new entity in a standardized justification field and both verifiers accept.
Scope-preservation rule: changes must be confined to pre-declared configuration blocks (e.g., interface, ACL) as indicated by the task metadata; parser enforces block deltas.
Path-presence check: for declared reachability properties, verify presence/absence of expected abstract paths in both primary and secondary verifiers; require agreement or flag.
automatic_rejection_rules: Reject final repair if syntactic parse fails (deterministic parser) -> mark pair unsalvageable.

Reject and request single auto-repair iteration if primary verifier FAIL returns concrete counterexample (adapter permits up to 1 guarded repair call). If second guarded attempt still fails, record final as FAIL.
If primary verifier PASS but secondary validator FAIL, flag item and treat as FAIL in conservative sensitivity analysis.
transformation_validation.audit_sample_policy: No human adjudication. Audit = deterministic dual-verifier disagreement set plus border cases where automated hallucination proxy score is within threshold band. For audit-set items, automatically re-run: (a) re-parse using alternate parser settings, (b) re-run secondary validator, and (c) produce conservative composite verdict (PASS only if both validators PASS). All audit actions and outcomes logged.
transformation_validation.mapping_validation: Vendor-dialect mapping validated by synthetic unit tests: feed canonical examples per dialect to parser and ensure parse success rate >=95% for declared dialects; failing dialects excluded from confirmatory strata or counted as unsalvageable.
residual_risks: Verifier soundness gaps may yield false PASS; mitigated via conservative sensitivity analyses but not fully removable.
Parser coverage may underrepresent exotic vendor extensions; such items will be deterministically excluded or logged as unsalvageable.

remaining_noncritical_uncertainties: External validity across real production topologies and undocumented vendor dialect extensions remains uncertain (U1). The confirmatory claims are bounded to the generator-profiled task population and declared dialect strata.
Verifier completeness: Batfish and the secondary validator reduce but may not eliminate undetected semantic errors; sensitivity analyses address this residual risk.
Automated hallucination-proxy is an imperfect surrogate for human adjudication; we provide sensitivity bounds rather than absolute hallucination counts.
